specification.title: Distinctive technique query retrieves the expected record first
specification.description: The distinctive Data Obfuscation technique query retrieves the expected technique first through the production parser/index/pgvector path.
specification.purpose: Verify the production parser, index, and pgvector path returns the Data Obfuscation technique record at the top rank for its distinctive query.
specification.operational_relevance: Retrieval quality determines whether research can ground claims in the right technique at all.
specification.regression_risk: Embedding or parsing regressions could demote or drop the expected technique record.

required: The expected technique source record is present in the retrieved set
The technique record ranks within the declared maximum rank
Only the declared source and document type are retrieved
forbidden: The expected relevant record is absent or ranks beyond the declared bound
